Name: VWW - Spooky Machines
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]

Mod entry for the SDV Discord Server Fall Event!

The wizard sends you mail with some recipes of particular machines in it as fall starts. They will produce items daily(similar to the bait maker or statue of endless fortune etc.).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
It should be compatible with anything, I hope!
